productScope: Callable retail domestic/NRO/NRE term deposits below INR 3 crore; standard table only

sourceReview.basis: Official IndusInd Bank fixed deposit interest rate page captured via read-only discovery. Table 0 contains all 17 callable retail slabs below INR 3 crore with 34 regular and senior rates. Non-callable table (Table 3) and October 13 2026 non-callable senior policy notice are explicitly distinguished and excluded from callable card rates.

policyReconciliation.scopeOfNotice: Withdrawal of resident senior citizen additional interest benefit on Non-Callable Fixed Deposits only; callable retail deposits retain senior benefits as published in Table 0.

eligibilityNotes: Resident Senior Citizen customers (aged 60 years and above) receive an additional interest benefit (+0.75% for 2 to 3 years, +0.50% for other tenures).
Senior citizen rates are NOT applicable to NRE/NRO deposits.
Minimum tenure for NRE fixed deposits is one year (365 days); sub-1-year slabs are not applicable to NRE deposits.
Non-callable deposits (Above 1 crore to less than 3 crores - Premature Withdrawal Not Allowed) are excluded from this callable adapter.
Bulk deposits (>= 3 Crore) and financial institution deposits are excluded from this retail adapter.
